note: Dage, folk faktisk fejrer ude i den virkelige verden. En fiktiv helligdag, ingen uden for vaerket holder, hoerer i 03_fiction.json.

days.why_da: „May the Fourth be with you.“ Hele helligdagen hviler på ét ordspil, og det er nok.
days.why_en: “May the Fourth be with you.” The entire holiday rests on one pun, and that is enough.

days.why_da: Dagen efter, og den er den mørke sides. Revenge of the Sith blev Revenge of the Fifth.
days.why_en: The day after, and it belongs to the dark side. Revenge of the Sith became Revenge of the Fifth.

days.work: The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy
days.why_da: Bær et håndklæde hele dagen. En rumrejsende, der har styr på sit håndklæde, er en, man regner med. Dagen blev holdt første gang to uger efter Douglas Adams' død i 2001.
days.why_en: Carry a towel all day. A space traveller who knows where their towel is commands respect. First observed two weeks after Douglas Adams died in 2001.

days.why_da: Datoen er ikke tilfældig: Star Wars havde premiere 25. maj 1977. Derfor falder den oven i håndklædedagen — den tættest befolkede dag i hele nørdekalenderen.
days.why_en: The date is no accident: Star Wars opened on 25 May 1977. Which is why it lands on top of Towel Day — the most crowded square in the whole nerd calendar.

days.why_da: 9/25 læses „9 to 5“, og så er det Dolly Partons dag. Tennessee gjorde den officiel, og New Orleans fulgte efter.
days.why_en: 9/25 reads as “9 to 5”, which makes it Dolly Parton's day. Tennessee made it official and New Orleans followed.

days.why_da: Et murmeldyr i Pennsylvania spår, om vinteren varer seks uger mere. Filmen fra 1993 gjorde navnet til et ord for en dag, der gentager sig selv.
days.why_en: A groundhog in Pennsylvania predicts whether winter has six weeks left. The 1993 film turned the name into a word for a day that repeats itself.

days.why_da: Den 21. oktober 2015 kl. 16.29 var destinationen, Doc tastede ind. Fremtiden er overhalet nu, og vi har stadig ingen hoverboards.
days.why_en: 21 October 2015 at 4:29 pm was the destination Doc punched in. That future is behind us now, and we still have no hoverboards.

days.why_da: Bilbos og Frodos fælles fødselsdag. Den rigtige måde at holde den er elleve måltider og ingen eventyr.
days.why_en: Bilbo and Frodo share this birthday. The correct way to mark it is eleven meals and no adventures.

days.why_da: Hele James Joyces Ulysses foregår på denne ene dag i 1904. I Dublin går man ruten igennem og spiser nyrer til morgenmad.
days.why_en: The whole of Joyce's Ulysses takes place on this single day in 1904. In Dublin people walk the route and eat kidneys for breakfast.

days.why_da: 11/07 er N7. Det er hele begrundelsen, og spillets fans holder den alvorligt.
days.why_en: 11/07 spells N7. That is the entire reasoning, and the fans take it seriously.

days.why_da: Doctor Who blev sendt første gang 23. november 1963 — dagen efter mordet på Kennedy, så næsten ingen så den.
days.why_en: Doctor Who first aired on 23 November 1963 — the day after Kennedy was shot, so almost nobody watched.

days.why_da: Den 8. september 1966 sendte NBC den første episode. Serien blev aflyst efter tre sæsoner og blev alligevel det hele.
days.why_en: On 8 September 1966 NBC aired the first episode. The show was cancelled after three seasons and became everything anyway.

days.why_da: Den 5. april 2063 møder menneskeheden vulcanerne i Bozeman, Montana. Fejres i dag af fans, der har 37 år til gode.
days.why_en: On 5 April 2063 humanity meets the Vulcans in Bozeman, Montana. Celebrated today by fans with 37 years still to wait.

days.why_da: Månen hedder LV-426, så dagen er 4/26. Nørdekalenderens reneste form for logik.
days.why_en: The moon is called LV-426, so the day is 4/26. The purest form of nerd-calendar logic.

days.why_da: MAR10 ser ud som MARIO, hvis man kniber øjnene sammen. Nintendo gjorde den officiel i 2016.
days.why_en: MAR10 looks like MARIO if you squint. Nintendo made it official in 2016.

days.why_da: To mænd fra Oregon opfandt den i 1995 under en squashkamp. Datoen er den enes ekskones fødselsdag, fordi den var let at huske.
days.why_en: Two men in Oregon invented it during a racquetball game in 1995. The date is one of their ex-wives' birthday, because it was easy to remember.

days.why_da: Den tredje lørdag i september. DC flyttede den rundt et par gange, før den landede her.
days.why_en: The third Saturday in September. DC moved it around a few times before it settled here.

days.why_da: Den første lørdag i maj giver tegneseriebutikker verden over hæfter væk. Opfundet i 2002 for at få folk ind ad døren.
days.why_en: On the first Saturday in May comic shops around the world give issues away. Invented in 2002 to get people through the door.

days.why_da: Den sidste fredag i juli. Den eneste dag om året, hvor man siger tak til den, der holder alting kørende.
days.why_en: The last Friday in July. The one day a year anybody thanks the person keeping everything running.
